# raff_member (Resource)

Manages an account-level member. Use one of (email, target_user_id, api_key_id) to identify the member at create time — they're mutually exclusive.

Inviting by email creates a pending member that becomes active when the recipient accepts the invitation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Role UUID. Must be account-scoped.

### Optional

- `api_key_id` (String) API key UUID to grant account-level access. Mutually exclusive with email and target_user_id.
- `email` (String) Email of the user to invite. Mutually exclusive with target_user_id and api_key_id.
- `status` (String) active or suspended. pending is set automatically for invited members until they accept.
- `target_user_id` (String) Existing user UUID to add directly. Mutually exclusive with email and api_key_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `role_name` (String)
